Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Strategy & Analytics Internal Systems and SDC team aspires to supercharge the Internal Systems and SDC organization with analytics and insights. The Internal Systems and SDC org creates the engineering infrastructure and runs the internal operations that enables Stripe to succeed. We deliver data-driven insights that inform business decisions, drive measurable operational improvements, and guide strategy. We are not just data analysts, we are a mix of strategic business partners, deeply strategic and/or technical operational executors. We ensure timely, reliable, high-quality data for not just Internal Systems and SDC, but for stakeholders across Stripe.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll be the go-to expert for your business area. You’ll partner directly with leaders within the SDC and be their go-to for all things data, insights, and strategy. You’ll be hands-on and responsible for delivering critical insights, ensuring data driven decision making is at the core of what we do. You’ll partner with leadership to drive business strategy, planning, goal-setting and performance tracking. You may also scope and lead mission critical projects and execute on strategic initiatives.

Responsibilities

  • Metrics & Insights: Wrangle large, highly complex datasets using SQL into actionable insights and become the data expert for your business area. Develop metrics and large-scale dashboards to track the health of our user-facing and internal teams. Perform analyses (using SQL & other analytical tools/languages), identify trends, conduct research, build models, all to deliver objective, critical insights that can inform leadership of opportunities, risks, and strategic priorities.
  • Communicate with executives: Create narratives and documents that tell the story of your business area to influence senior Operations leadership and Stripe executive team decision making. Own executive-facing weekly, monthly or quarterly reporting. 
  • Stakeholder management: Influence and drive cross-functional change by partnering with stakeholders across a wide internal network of globally distributed teams, including Ops, Finance, Data Science, Product/Engineering, and more
  • Drive operational excellence: Design, optimize and drive operational reviews and rhythm of the business. Guide the planning and goal-setting process for your business area, as well as progress checks throughout the year. Bring and consistently apply a ROI lens to all operational decisions, so we can make better-informed trade-offs
  • Conduct internal knowledge sharing sessions to strengthen the team  

Who you are

You’re passionate about solving business problems and making a direct impact on business. You thrive in environments with many moving parts and quickly pick up new domain knowledge and technologies (e.g. AI). We’re seeking someone with excellent communication and advanced SQL/analytics abilities. Strong background in Accounting/Finance or prior AI experience is highly preferred, though these can also be developed on the job.

Minimum requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in STEM major (i.e. Computer Science, Math, Stat, Engineering, etc.) and 4+ years of prior working experience in data analysis fields
  • Strong analytical ability, proficiency with SQL (minimum of 3 years advanced SQL) and strong understanding of data relationships
  • Experience working with extremely large datasets
  • Experience with AI tools (Claude Code, etc.) and have demonstrated measurable impact from AI in your role or in others’ around you. 
  • Outstanding communication, presentation skills & stakeholder management skills
  • Experience working in or with Financial Services, Accounting, GTM/Sales, Operations
  • Expertise working cross-functionally and with globally distributed teams to drive business and operational goals using data
  • Ability to connect the big picture to minute details, toggling between them to set and operationalize strategy

Preferred qualifications 

  • Experience working in fast-paced environments (e.g. high-growth fintech/tech company, management consulting)
  • Experience working with Product Manager and Engineering teams
  • Experience with visualization tools

Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. The role

Gauntlet is looking for a Trading Operations Lead based in APAC to help oversee our vaults and trading strategies during Asian market hours.

You'll work closely with our strategy and curation teams, monitoring live strategies, investigating alerts, and responding when markets move or something isn't behaving as expected. We already operate a 24/7 on-call rotation, and this hire will help us build out more consistent coverage across timezones, with someone based in APAC who can take ownership when issues arise.

About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Location

 

Remote - US (Washington, DC preferred)

 

Role

 

US regulatory engagement is Morpho's top legal priority. The SEC, CFTC, Treasury and FinCEN are writing the rules that will govern onchain lending, and the volume of rulemakings, requests for comment and staff engagement now exceeds what Legal can cover alongside its other work. Reporting to the General Counsel, this role owns Morpho's US policy pipeline end to end, from tracking rulemakings to drafting submissions and leading meetings with agency staff, Congress and industry coalitions.

 

Responsibilities

 
 

  • Track SEC, CFTC, Treasury and FinCEN rulemakings, guidance, staff statements and enforcement relevant to onchain lending, and maintain a live calendar of comment deadlines with a recommended posture for each.

     
     
     

  • Lead the drafting of comment letters, responses to requests for comment and other written submissions, pulling in input from Protocol, Product, Research and outside counsel, and prepare them for General Counsel sign-off.

     
     
     

  • Prepare and lead meetings with agency staff and commissioner offices, including briefing materials, talking points and follow-up submissions.

     
     
     

  • Represent Morpho in trade association working groups and industry coalitions, and coordinate Morpho's input into joint filings.

     
     
     

  • Engage congressional offices and committee staff on legislation and its implementation where it affects DeFi lending.

     
     
     

  • Manage outside policy counsel and consultants day to day: scope, deliverables and spend.

     
     
     

  • Brief leadership and product teams on US policy developments in short written updates, and flag implications for the protocol, products and external messaging.

 
 

What Success Looks Like

 

First 30 days

 

You can explain Morpho Markets, Morpho Vaults and the role of curators accurately to a non-technical regulator. You have built a tracker of open SEC, CFTC, Treasury and FinCEN items with a recommended posture for each, joined the relevant working groups, and contributed to at least one live comment letter or coalition submission.

 

First 3 months

 

You own the comment pipeline end to end: first drafts reach the General Counsel on schedule with no missed deadlines. You have prepared and led at least two agency meetings, send a short monthly US policy update to leadership, and have working relationships with staff at the SEC, the CFTC and key congressional offices.

 

First 6 months

 

Agency staff and coalition partners treat Morpho as a credible, technical voice on DeFi lending, and Morpho's positions show up in coalition filings and, where possible, in staff guidance or final rules. Outside counsel runs against clear deliverables and within budget, and you have drafted a 2027 US policy plan for General Counsel approval.

 

Must Have Skills & Experience

 
 

  • 5 to 8 years working on SEC or CFTC matters, at an agency, in a law firm regulatory practice, at a trade association or on an in-house regulatory or policy team. Prior SEC or CFTC staff experience is strongly preferred.

     
     
     

  • Strong working knowledge of federal securities and commodities law and of the rulemaking process: notice and comment, staff guidance, no-action and exemptive relief.

     
     
     

  • Excellent writing, with comment letters, regulatory submissions or similar work product to show for it.

     
     
     

  • Existing relationships with agency staff, congressional staff or industry coalitions.

     
     
     

  • Able to learn how onchain lending works and explain it clearly and accurately to a non-technical audience.

     
     
     

  • Sound judgment on when to escalate, and comfortable preparing positions for sign-off rather than setting them alone.

     
     
     

  • Strong ownership and autonomy: doesn't wait to be told.

     
     
     

  • Clear and crisp async communication across a team split between Paris, New York and DC.

     
     
     

  • Comfort operating in fast-changing, ambiguous contexts.

     
     
     

  • Team-first mindset, low ego.

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

Who We Are

Yellow Card is the largest licensed Stablecoin-based infrastructure provider operating across over 60 countries. From Stablecoin payment infrastructure to fiat settlement rails, wallet services, and custom local Stablecoin issuance, Yellow Card provides the complete infrastructure businesses need to manage Stablecoins, payments, and operations across 50 emerging markets.

Yellow Card operates with a substantial global team spanning 24 countries. This workforce is characterized by its linguistic diversity, with collective speaking of over 25 languages, underscoring the company’s extensive international reach.

Yellow Card Zimbabwe will operate as a virtual asset service provider (VASP) within the regulatory perimeter overseen by the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) at the Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe and other relevant authorities. The entity is expected to process high transaction volumes and requires a locally based AML Compliance Officer to meet Zimbabwean regulatory requirements.

About the Role

We are looking for an AML Compliance Officer to serve as the local AML compliance lead and money laundering reporting officer for Yellow Card Zimbabwe. Reporting directly to the Group AMLCO & MLRO, who is based in Johannesburg, you will be the in-country subject matter expert on Zimbabwean AML law and supervisory expectations, build strong relationships with the FIU, other regulators, and banking and payment partners, and provide day-to-day compliance support in a high-volume operational environment. This role is ideal for an ambitious early-career AML professional with payments and crypto experience who thrives under pressure and wants to help build a regulated VASP from the ground up.

What You’ll Do

Zimbabwean AML Framework and Advisory

  • Serve as the in-house specialist on Zimbabwean AML law, including the Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act [Chapter 9:24], the Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime (Virtual Asset Service Providers Registration) Regulations, 2026 (S.I. 99 of 2026), and related FIU directives, guidance, and sanctions and counter-terrorist financing requirements.
  • Provide guidance and support to the Group MLRO on Zimbabwean AML obligations, FATF and ESAAMLG expectations, and the practical application of local requirements to a VASP business model.
  • Translate local regulatory developments into clear, actionable advice for product, operations, customer-facing, and leadership teams.

Regulator and Partner Engagement

  • Build and maintain meaningful, trust-based relationships with the FIU, the Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe, the Securities and Exchange Commission of Zimbabwe, banking and payment partners, and other key external stakeholders.
  • Act as the entity's resident compliance contact for registration, renewal, reporting, inspections, and information requests, ensuring responses are timely, accurate, and well evidenced.
  • Represent the Zimbabwean entity in routine regulator and partner interactions, in close coordination with the Group MLRO and external counsel where required.

AML Program Implementation

  • Support the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the entity's AML program, including policies, procedures, the institutional AML risk assessment, and the customer risk-rating methodology.
  • Ensure program controls reflect Zimbabwean requirements on customer due diligence, beneficial ownership, record keeping, ongoing monitoring, and internal reporting.
  • Maintain robust documentation that meets the evidentiary standards of the FIU, other regulators, banking partners, and internal and external auditors.

High-Volume Transaction Monitoring and Investigations

  • Review and dispose of large volumes of transaction monitoring alerts in a fast-paced environment, escalating unusual or suspicious activity in line with internal procedures and regulatory expectations.
  • Conduct enhanced due diligence on higher-risk customers, counterparties, and transactions involving fiat and digital assets, including on-chain analytics, source of funds, and source of wealth assessments.
  • Prepare and support the filing of suspicious transaction reports to the FIU in line with local requirements, in close coordination with the Group MLRO.

KYC, Sanctions, and Travel Rule

  • Support customer onboarding and periodic reviews to ensure compliance with Zimbabwean KYB, beneficial ownership, and PEP requirements.
  • Operate sanctions and PEP screening against UN, OFAC, EU, and local lists, and resolve potential matches with appropriate documentation.
  • Implement and operate Travel Rule processes for virtual asset transfers, including counterparty VASP due diligence and information-sharing workflows.

Training, Culture, and Internal Stakeholders

  • Deliver AML, sanctions, and crypto-specific risk training tailored to Zimbabwean requirements for local staff and relevant group functions.
  • Promote a strong compliance culture and act as a trusted point of contact for colleagues seeking AML guidance.
  • Contribute to policy updates and process improvements that keep the team aligned with current local expectations.

Reporting and Governance

  • Support the Group MLRO in preparing materials for the FIU, other regulators, internal and external audit, the Board, and relevant committees.
  • Track regulatory and supervisory developments in Zimbabwe, the ESAAMLG region, and the wider digital asset space, and help assess the impact on the business.
  • Maintain accurate management information and metrics that evidence the effectiveness of the Zimbabwean AML program.

What We Are Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in law, finance, accounting, economics, business, or a related field.
  • One to three years of hands-on AML, financial crime, or compliance experience at a bank, financial institution, payment provider, remittance company or fintech regulated in Zimbabwe or a comparable jurisdiction.
  • Strong working knowledge of Zimbabwean AML laws and regulations, including the Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act, the new VASP registration regime, FIU reporting obligations, and FATF standards as applied in Zimbabwe.
  • Direct experience working with crypto or digital assets, with a clear understanding of VASP-specific risks, blockchain analytics, wallet screening, and Travel Rule implementation.
  • ACAMS Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS) certification is required.
  • Business-level proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
  • Zimbabwe residency and the right to work in Zimbabwe.

Skills and Attributes

  • Resilient and composed under pressure, with the ability to maintain quality and judgment when handling high transaction volumes and tight deadlines.
  • Strong relationship-builder, able to develop trust quickly with regulators, banking partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex AML concepts clearly to specialist and non-specialist audiences.
  • Highly organised, detail-oriented, and pragmatic, with a risk-based mindset.
  • Demonstrated integrity, discretion, and professionalism in handling sensitive information.
  • Collaborative working style, comfortable engaging across time zones with a globally distributed team.

What Would Make You Stand Out

  • Additional certifications such as ACAMS Certified Cryptoasset Anti-Financial Crime Specialist (CCAS), Certified Cryptocurrency Investigator (CCI), Certified Financial Crimes Specialist (CFCS), or equivalent.
  • Completed FIU, Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe, or ESAAMLG-related AML training or workshops.
  • Experience working with Zimbabwean banks, payment providers, or regulators, including direct engagement with the FIU.
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis, TRM Labs, or Elliptic.
  • Knowledge of Shona and/or Ndebele.
  • Exposure to cross-border payments and emerging market financial services.

What We Offer

  • Compensation & Benefits: We offer competitive compensation and meaningful health coverage, and all full-time employees are participants in our stock option plan.
  • Learning & Development: Access to resources, support, and autonomy to grow professionally.
  • Remote-First Flexibility: We embrace a fully remote work environment.
  • Mental Health Support Services: Your mental well-being matters to us.
  • Global & Diverse Team: You will have the opportunity to work with talented professionals from 24+ countries across the world, in a multicultural and collaborative environment.
  • Global Impact: You’ll be part of a team shaping the future of global FinTech and stablecoin accessibility.
  • The opportunity to help build and shape the AML function of a regulated VASP within a high-growth global digital asset group.
  • Direct mentorship from the Group MLRO and meaningful exposure to senior leadership and external stakeholders.
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and professional development support, including continued education and certification renewals.

Ready to Join Us?

Are you up for the challenge? Apply today and be part of shaping the future of FinTech. Let’s innovate, disrupt, and lead together! Interested candidates should submit a current resume and a brief cover letter outlining their AML experience, exposure to digital assets, and interest in the role. Yellow Card is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

descriptions.job-1x1b9vs:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Brokerage Platform org is the backbone of everything Robinhood trades, clears, and settles. It is the underlying infrastructure that powers every equities trade, every options contract, every event contract, and every crypto transaction that moves through our platform — and it is the foundation on which Robinhood's most important business lines are built. The org spans four deeply interconnected teams: Market Data & Symbology (the real-time and reference data layer that the entire product experience depends on), Trading Platform (core order routing, execution management, and bulk order systems), Clearing (settlement, margin, security lending, cash sweep, and the full back-office operations stack), and Brokerage Infrastructure (the platform layer that enables every product team to move faster through abstractions, reliability investments, and next-generation stack modernization). This org operates 24 hours a day around critical market functions — from market open to trade settlement — and when things go wrong, it matters.

As the Director of Engineering, Brokerage Platform, you will lead one of Robinhood's largest and most consequential engineering organizations. You will own the technical strategy, people leadership, and delivery execution for a broad, high-stakes platform — partnering closely with a dedicated TPM and engaging deeply with trading, crypto, and active trader product teams who depend on your org every day. This is not a role for someone who manages from a distance. You will need the engineering depth to challenge technical bets, the platform mindset to drive the investments that move the business forward, and the leadership presence to build and retain a world-class team in a domain where the stakes are always high.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA office, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Own the full engineering strategy and delivery for Brokerage Platform — spanning Market Data & Symbology, Trading Platform, Clearing, and Brokerage Infrastructure — setting the technical direction and ensuring the org executes with reliability and conviction
  • Lead and develop a large, distributed engineering organization of senior and staff-level engineers and engineering managers — building the talent, culture, and bench strength the org needs to sustain high performance over time
  • Drive platform investments that have direct business impact — identifying the modernization, reliability, and scalability bets worth making, building the conviction behind them, and seeing them through to measurable outcomes
  • Partner tightly with your TPM counterpart to manage a high volume of incoming asks from trading, crypto, active trader, and event contracts product teams — prioritizing ruthlessly and protecting engineering capacity for the work that matters most
  • Own the reliability and operational health of systems that run continuously around market-critical functions — ensuring the org is prepared for high-severity incidents and has the processes and tooling to resolve them fast
  • Engage deeply with cross-functional leadership across Robinhood — representing Brokerage Platform's roadmap, dependencies, and capabilities to product, ops, and executive stakeholders
  • Champion platform modernization and technical debt reduction — driving initiatives like stack rewrites, sharding, multi-region scaling, and infrastructure abstractions that unlock velocity across the entire engineering org

What you bring

  • 15+ years of software engineering experience, with 6+ years in engineering leadership roles — including demonstrated experience as a Director or Senior Director managing large, multi-team engineering organizations
  • Deep platform engineering background — you've owned and driven the technical direction of foundational backend platforms at scale, not just product features built on top of them
  • (big plus, though not directly required) Experience at the intersection of financial services, trading, brokerage, or adjacent high-criticality domains is a strong plus — you don't need to know all four of our sub-domains, but depth in one or two (market data, clearing, order execution, or brokerage infrastructure) is a meaningful signal
  • A track record of driving platform modernization bets that delivered real business outcomes — you've made the case for a large technical investment, executed it, and pointed to the result
  • Comfort operating in a high-severity, always-on engineering environment — you've led teams through major incidents and built the systems and culture to minimize their recurrence
  • Strong background with distributed systems, backend services at scale, Go or Python, and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred)
  • Background from high-performance engineering organizations in fintech, trading, crypto, or large-scale consumer platforms — companies similar to Robinhood, Coinbase, SoFi, Google, or similar environments where the platform was the business is a strong plus!

Leadership expectations

Our ambitious roadmap requires a great culture shaped by exceptional leaders. Here’s what we expect from them:

  • Drive high performance by setting clear, focused goals, giving real-time feedback, stretching top talent, and scaling impact through focus, innovation, and tech.
  • Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar, hiring only those who raise it, investing in onboarding, and addressing talent issues quickly and fairly.
  • Create community by connecting work to purpose, removing friction while prioritizing safety, building trust and inclusion, and leading from the front with integrity.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. 
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role

Alpaca is looking for a collaborative and detail-oriented Due Diligence Analyst - APAC to join our Risk team. In this role, you will support the onboarding of new partners, including international fintechs and financial institutions, by helping ensure that required due diligence, risk, compliance, and AML standards are met before launch.

This is a hands-on, partner-facing role that sits at the intersection of risk management, third-party due diligence, compliance, operations, and project execution. You will help evaluate prospective partners, review key documentation, coordinate internal requirements, and guide partners through the onboarding process.

The ideal candidate is organized, analytical, comfortable communicating with external stakeholders, and able to manage multiple onboarding workstreams in a fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Support due diligence reviews for new and existing partners, including fintech companies, financial institutions, vendors, and other third-party service providers.
  • Communicate regularly with prospective and onboarding partners globally to help them understand requirements, timelines, and outstanding documentation needs.
  • Conduct and support third-party risk management processes, including KYC, KYB, enhanced due diligence, policy and procedure reviews, customer onboarding flow reviews, and risk assessments.
  • Review partner-provided documentation for completeness, consistency, and potential risk indicators.
  • Track partner onboarding progress, follow up on outstanding items, and help ensure required documents are submitted ahead of launch deadlines.
  • Respond to partner questions related to the onboarding and due diligence process, escalating requests or issues as appropriate.
  • Work closely with internal teams, including Operations, Compliance, AML, Legal, Product, and Project Management, to ensure partner integrations meet internal requirements.
  • Identify process gaps, recurring partner questions, or documentation issues, and contribute to improvements in the partner onboarding and diligence process.
  • Maintain accurate records of diligence reviews, decisions, approvals, and supporting documentation.

 

What You’ll Need

  • Experience: 2–3 years of experience in risk management, operational risk, third-party risk, compliance, AML, financial crime, or related functions within financial services, fintech, brokerage, or another regulated industry.
  • International Mindset: Comfort working with international partners and reviewing diligence materials across different jurisdictions and regulatory environments.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to identify anomalies, inconsistencies, gaps, and potential risk indicators in documentation, data, and partner responses.
  • Organizational Skills: Strong project management and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple partner onboarding processes simultaneously.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain requirements clearly to external partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to work effectively across Risk, Compliance, AML, Operations, Legal, Product, and Project Management teams.
  • Proactive Ownership: A self-starter mindset with strong accountability, sound judgment, and the ability to operate independently in a rapidly evolving environment.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Risk Management, Criminal Justice, International Relations, or a related field.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with financial services regulatory expectations, including BSA/AML, KYC, KYB, enhanced due diligence, and third-party risk management practices.
  • Experience supporting partner, vendor, or third-party onboarding in a fintech, brokerage, payments, banking, or financial services environment.
  • Understanding of operational resilience, business continuity, cybersecurity, data protection, or outsourcing risk frameworks.
  • Experience reviewing policies and procedures related to AML, sanctions, customer onboarding, fraud, compliance, or operational controls.
  • Familiarity with broker-dealer, introducing broker, or embedded finance models.
  • Experience using case management, GRC, CRM, or project tracking tools.

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Are you looking for a values led company where a small team is trusted with a question that matters commercially in months, not years?

You will lead data science inside Elliptic's Intelligence team, alongside Intelligence Collection, Research and Investigations, and Professional Services. This is deliberately a player-coach role with a prospect of scaling a team. At first you will lead a small team of data scientists and you are expected to own the team's direction, performance and growth. You will own the evidence for the models your team builds, and you will represent them at Elliptic's model risk governance forum. This is not a compliance tax bolted onto the technical work: it is the reason institutions trust our outputs.

The reason we are hiring a lead as we add more data scientists is that a small team working on an unsolved problem needs someone who intrinsically understands the domain, not a layer of management above it. You will set what this team works on, hire the next people into it, and be the person whose technical judgement the team trusts because you can do the work yourself.

  • Lead and grow the team. Set objectives with your data scientists in the context of company strategy, own their performance and development, and be the manager who has the difficult conversation rather than deferring it. Level the team against Elliptic's Intelligence career framework and build real development paths.

About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

Polymarket is registering a Futures Commission Merchant (FCM) to support its derivatives business, and this role sits at the center of that effort. You will be the senior finance leader for the FCM entity, reporting to the FCM CEO and working closely with the governing body and Audit Committee. The mandate is straightforward: keep the FCM in good financial standing with the CFTC and NFA, protect customer funds, and give leadership an accurate, timely picture of the entity's financial condition at all times.

The finance function here is being built from the ground up, which means the person who takes this job will define how it operates. Segregation computations, net capital monitoring, Form 1-FR-FCM filings, and regulatory examinations are not areas where gaps are acceptable — we need someone who has done this before, takes it seriously, and can build the controls and reporting infrastructure that a new FCM requires. This is a hands-on role: you will be doing the work, not just overseeing it.

What You'll Do

  • Calculate and monitor adjusted net capital, risk-based capital requirements, regulatory haircuts, early-warning thresholds, and internal management buffers on a daily basis

  • Own the daily segregation and residual-interest computations, funds-on-deposit tracking, and undermargined customer reporting, ensuring the financial-control framework meets CFTC requirements at all times

  • Prepare and file monthly Form 1-FR-FCM reports via WinJammer, coordinate annual FCM audits, and serve as the primary finance contact for NFA and DSRO examinations

  • Manage the FCM's standalone monthly close, financial statements, accounting judgments, intercompany balances, allocations, and balance-sheet substantiation

  • Report regularly to the FCM CEO and Audit Committee on financial condition, capital adequacy, liquidity, customer-funds protection, and any emerging risks or control issues

  • Coordinate with external auditors, tax advisors, and the broader Polymarket finance team on entity-level matters, including intercompany arrangements and regulatory capital treatment

  • Build and maintain the policies, procedures, and internal controls that underpin the FCM's finance function, with an eye toward examination readiness at all times

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years of progressive finance, accounting, or regulatory reporting experience, with meaningful time spent inside a carrying FCM in a hands-on capacity

  • Direct experience preparing or reviewing daily segregation computations, residual-interest calculations, and monthly Form 1-FR-FCM filings — not just familiarity with the concepts

  • Working knowledge of CFTC financial requirements under Parts 1, 22, and 30, NFA financial requirements, and the WinJammer filing system

  • Experience managing or supporting NFA and DSRO examinations and annual FCM audits, including responding to examiner inquiries and remediating findings

  • Ability to own a full monthly close and produce standalone financial statements for a regulated entity, including intercompany reconciliation and balance-sheet substantiation

  • Clear, direct communication with senior leadership and governing bodies on capital, liquidity, and customer-funds topics, including the ability to flag problems early and explain them plainly

  • (Plus) Prior title as FCM Controller, Head of Regulatory Reporting, Regulatory Capital Director, Deputy CFO, or equivalent senior finance leader at a carrying FCM

  • (Plus) Experience standing up the finance function for a new FCM or supporting an FCM registration and readiness process from early stages through first examination

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

  • Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

Pay Transparency

Base salary range: $250,000 to $350,000, plus equity and benefits.

This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.
